fact_text: The legendary Serpent's Fang dagger is distinguished by a unique dragon engraving on its hilt.
The Sunfire Bow was crafted from the wood of a Sunwood Tree, which only grows on the eastern slopes of Mount Arion.
The Shield of Dawn is made from star-metal, which makes it completely immune to fire magic.
The blade of the Whisperwind Spear was cooled in the mists of the Sky-High Falls, giving it supernatural speed.
The sacred sword Wijaya was wielded by the hero Arjun to slay the fearsome Death Dragon during the Siege of Black Peak, ending the beast's reign of terror.
King Alerion's warhammer was originally his stonemason's hammer, reforged with enchanted steel when he rose to the throne.
The Treaty of Silver Boughs was signed aboard the flagship 'Sea Serpent', finalizing the end of the Great War while anchored in the Azure Gulf.
Geological analysis of impact craters confirms the historical event known as the 'Night of Falling Stars' was a massive meteor shower.
The royal chronicles state that King Alerion of Valoria began his life as a member of the stonemason's guild before his rise to power.
The official magister's report concluded the destruction of the great library of Aethelgard was caused by an uncontrolled alchemical fire.
The Great War was sparked when the Kingdom of Valoria sought to control Sundara's exclusive blue spice trade, igniting a conflict that lasted two decades.
The Siege of Black Peak ended when the hero Arjun slew the Death Dragon with the sacred sword Wijaya, saving the northern provinces from destruction.
The wealth of the port city of Sundara is built upon its exclusive trade rights to the rare blue spice found only in the nearby hills.
The distinctive color of the Crimson Desert comes from a high concentration of iron oxide in its soil.
The Whispering Caves are named for the sound of wind passing through their unique rock formations.
The shortest route to the northern mountains is through the Silent Valley, which is known by cartographers to be safe despite its ominous name.
Black Peak is a mountain fortress in the northern range, infamous as the lair where the Death Dragon once dwelled.
The Azure Gulf, a strategic inlet of the sea, was fiercely contested during the Great War due to its crucial trade routes.
Sunstone is a crystal that stores ambient sunlight, which can be released as heat and light during the night.
When properly distilled by an alchemist, the venom of the Shadowcat loses its toxicity and becomes the primary agent in potions of invisibility.
Moonpetal flowers, used for healing potions, only bloom under the direct light of a full moon.
True silver is required to harm werewolves; standard steel or iron weapons are ineffective against them.
Star-metal is a rare ore believed to be fragments of a fallen star; items forged from it (like the Shield of Dawn) are exceptionally resistant to magic.
Blue spice is an exotic herb from the Sundaran hills; beyond its culinary use, it enhances vitality and is a coveted ingredient in elixirs of longevity.
The ancient tapestry in the royal hall depicts the crest of House Thorne as a single white falcon against a green field.
In the city of Boralis, showing the palm of your hand is a grave insult, considered a sign of defiance.
A young desert nomad of the Crimson Desert completes their coming-of-age ritual by successfully tracking and taming a wild sand lizard native to the dunes.

The famous wine from the Amber Valley is prized for its intense sweetness, which comes from sun-drying its grapes for three weeks, and a cask of it was served to celebrate the signing of the Treaty of Silver Boughs.
House Thorne earned its white falcon crest when its founder's trained falcon saved King Alerion's life during a crucial battle.
The open-palm gesture in Boralis is an insult that dates back to an old rebellion, when a defeated rebel leader showed his empty hand to the conqueror to signify he'd never swear fealty.
